## PR description
### [Misc] Add vLLM-Omni PR review skill  [labels: documentation]
## Purpose

Add a repo-native `review-pr` skill for maintainer-style vLLM-Omni reviews.

The skill uses the [personal `vllm-omni-review` references](https://github.com/hsliuustc0106/vllm-omni-skills/tree/main/skills/vllm-omni-review/references) as its semantic baseline while keeping progressive disclosure:

- a 231-line core workflow;
- 31 concise, selectively loaded references and 1,639 total lines including UI metadata, versus roughly 4,151 lines in the personal baseline;
- no personal workflow scripts.

References follow review load order in five shallow groups: `process/`, `modules/`, `features/`, `checks/`, and `delivery/`. Every reference remains directly linked from `SKILL.md`; there are no folder indexes or deeper nesting.

The review model now separates four concerns:

1. always-on general correctness, compatibility, lifecycle, security, documentation, typed-API, utility-reuse, class-cohesion, feature-design, inference-interface rationale, bug-fix regression, performance A/B, recipe-template, and new-model evidence rules;
2. branch-local design-contract resolution, including page status, ownership boundary, dependencies, path exceptions, candidate invariants, and staleness;
3. one primary module contract, with a second only for a documented live cross-boundary path;
4. every matching feature-design and evidence overlay.

Routing mirrors the maintained [vLLM-Omni design index](https://docs.vllm.ai/projects/vllm-omni/en/latest/design/): all 21 active module pages and 26 feature pages are represented. Module designs provide the primary ownership axis; feature designs add cross-module behavior checks. Reviews inspect the frozen head's `docs/design/` pages first, use published latest docs only for discovery, treat draft candidate invariants as questions unless code/tests/policy enforce them, and require contract-changing PRs to update the owning design pages.

Executable validation for fork heads now requires a disposable, secret-free sandbox with restricted filesystem, network, and resources; otherwise review is limited to static SHA-addressed inspection and existing CI. Snapshot fingerprints cover tracked, index, untracked, and ignored state and are rechecked before every validation group and delivery.

Comment delivery remains calibrated against a reproducible study of 928 PRs merged in the 90 days through 2026-08-08. The study ranks substantive human inline threads, inspects the leading reviews and follow-up replies, and promotes only repeated practices or current repository guidance.

The skill can also identify or explicitly request focused owner reviews. It resolves the frozen head's last matching `.github/CODEOWNERS` rule, uses active module `owners` and `required_reviewers` plus governance expertise to rank contract specialists, excludes the author/bots/satisfied or duplicate requests, and selects one to three reviewers. It previews an explicit module/feature-contract comment before writing. Suggestions remain read-only; reviewer requests and `@mention` comments require separate explicit authorization and a fresh head check.

SHA-materialized remote snapshots, byte-fingerprinted local state, bounded validation, repeat-review safety, concise P0-P2 findings, and a read-only default are preserved.

This supplies the `review-pr` skill already listed in `.claude/skills/readme.md`.
